name: The Consequences Of Sin
overview: Scripture reveals that sin originates from deception and rebellion against God's clear commands, as seen in the serpent's subtle temptation in Genesis 3:1. Sin leads to spiritual separation from God, hiding His face and causing a breakdown in fellowship (Isaiah 59:2). The consequences are severe and personal, culminating in death for the soul that sins (Ezekiel 18:20) and eternal punishment if unrepented, as warned in Mark 9:43. All have sinned and fallen short of God's glory (Romans 3:23), often following paths that seem right but ultimately lead to death (Proverbs 14:12).
